name: @uae/data-plane
description: Data-plane authorization service: consumes compiled policy artifacts and answers check/checkBatch over HTTP

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @uae/policy run build && pnpm --filter @uae/evaluator run build && pnpm --filter @uae/persistence run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @uae/policy run build && pnpm --filter @uae/evaluator run build && pnpm --filter @uae/persistence run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
